lessons.title: Practice List Creation, Indexing, and len
lessons.description: Finish get_first_and_sum(numbers). Return a tuple of the first item (numbers[0]) and the sum of every item. The test checks that get_first_and_sum([10, 20, 30]) equals (10, 60).

lessons.title: Practice List Concatenation Membership
lessons.description: Finish combine_and_check(list1, list2, target). Join the two lists with +, then return whether target is in that combined list. combine_and_check([1, 2], [3, 4], 3) is true, and the same lists with target 5 are false. The test checks that combine_and_check([1, 2], [3, 4], 3) is true; combine_and_check([1, 2], [3, 4], 5) is false.
